conference.name: DevConf 2025
conference.location: Metro Convention Center, San Francisco, CA

featuredKeynote.title: The Next Decade of the Web
featuredKeynote.description: A look at the technologies, patterns, and platforms that will define the web over the next ten years.

tracks.name: Frontend
tracks.description: UI engineering, frameworks, accessibility, and design systems.

tracks.name: Backend
tracks.description: APIs, databases, distributed systems, and scaling.

tracks.name: AI & ML
tracks.description: Models, tooling, and practical applications of AI.

tracks.name: DevOps & Cloud
tracks.description: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and reliability.

tracks.name: Design & UX
tracks.description: Product design, research, and interaction patterns.

speakers.name: Ava Thompson
speakers.title: Principal Engineer
speakers.bio: Ava has spent 15 years building web platforms and leads the platform team at Nimbus Labs. She is a frequent keynote speaker and open-source contributor.

speakers.name: Marcus Chen
speakers.title: Staff Software Engineer
speakers.bio: Marcus builds distributed systems at Orbital and writes about reliability engineering. He previously worked on database internals at ScaleWorks.

speakers.name: Priya Raman
speakers.title: ML Engineer
speakers.bio: Priya works on applied machine learning and model evaluation. She is passionate about making AI tools usable for non-experts.

speakers.name: Diego Alvarez
speakers.title: Site Reliability Lead
speakers.bio: Diego leads SRE at Cloudline and has helped teams adopt infrastructure as code and observability best practices.

speakers.name: Sofia Lindgren
speakers.title: Design Director
speakers.bio: Sofia designs products used by millions and advocates for accessible, research-driven design.

speakers.name: Noah Park
speakers.title: Developer Advocate
speakers.bio: Noah helps developers ship faster on the edge. He is a regular meetup organizer and content creator.

speakers.name: Isabella Rossi
speakers.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
speakers.bio: Isabella focuses on design systems and motion. She has led accessibility initiatives across large product teams.

speakers.name: Kwame Osei
speakers.title: Backend Architect
speakers.bio: Kwame designs data platforms and writes about API design and event-driven architectures.

schedule.title: The Next Decade of the Web
schedule.description: A look at the technologies, patterns, and platforms that will define the web over the next ten years.

schedule.title: Designing Reliable APIs at Scale
schedule.description: Practical patterns for versioning, error handling, and observability in large-scale APIs.

schedule.title: Evaluating LLMs for Production
schedule.description: How to measure quality, latency, and cost when putting language models into real products.

schedule.title: Infrastructure as Code: Lessons Learned
schedule.description: Real-world stories from teams adopting IaC and the pitfalls to avoid.

schedule.title: Research-Driven Design Systems
schedule.description: How to ground design systems in user research and keep them accessible.

schedule.title: Shipping Faster on the Edge
schedule.description: Edge runtimes, caching, and deployment strategies for low-latency experiences.

schedule.title: Motion with Meaning
schedule.description: Using animation to improve usability without sacrificing accessibility.

schedule.title: Practical AI Tooling for Devs
schedule.description: Tools and workflows that bring AI into everyday development tasks.

schedule.title: Edge Cases in Edge Caching
schedule.description: A deep dive into cache invalidation and consistency at the edge.

schedule.title: Event-Driven Architecture in Practice
schedule.description: Patterns for building resilient systems with events, queues, and streams.
